source_basis: Supported raw command inventory is reconciled from sim-core/simulator_coverage/pokemon-showdown-0.11.10-gen9randombattle.json protocol.commands and the current TypeScript observable parser; package-wide emitter scans are not reachability closure.
Per-record validation logic is checked by the shared accepted-record and rejection fixture matrix in both runtimes.
Signed -setboost is supported from pinned pokemon-showdown@0.11.10 sim/battle.ts:1941-1942; a Contrary plus Belly Drum callback emits the resulting negative stage.
Bounded -invertboost is accepted for the scoped base Topsy-Turvy contract at data/moves.ts:20427-20436; Gen9SSB Rigged Dice remains excluded.

CE-02 validates the public Gen 9 auto-tie warning emitted by sim/battle.ts:1761-1767; ordered HP/heal/stage tag kinds are source-singleton from Battle.add/addMove/attrLastMove; private requests, errors, and split transport markers cannot enter the spectator prefix.

disposition_rules.supported: Accept only the exact command token with its grouped record validator. Raw-only records are retained verbatim and do not imply typed state support.
disposition_rules.recognized_unsupported: Reject before side routing or publication. Aliases carry an unresolved-alias diagnostic. Unsupported singlemove forms reject as malformed before commit.
disposition_rules.malformed_supported: Reject before side routing and publication. Episode handling classifies malformed evidence as failed; it is not a supported mechanic.
disposition_rules.unknown: Reject before side routing and publication; episode handling truncates on unsupported protocol.
disposition_rules.privacy: Requests remain private; only the sanitized rqid record is allowed in a public prefix. All other request JSON is rejected at publication.

bigerror.auto_tie: You will auto-tie if the battle doesn't end in <N> turn(s) (on turn 1000).
